/home.title: Ivan Ho — Computer Science, Mathematics and Music
/home.description: Ivan Le Kang Ho: computer science and mathematics at Stanford, composer and performer, from Auckland, New Zealand.

/impact.title: Work and Impact — Ivan Ho
/impact.description: Software and data engineering at the Cancer Society of New Zealand, research on authorship inequality and speech technology, and teaching Python in Chin State.

/creative.title: Composer and Performer — Ivan Ho
/creative.description: Choral and chamber composition, recital performance, and the ensembles behind them. Scores, recordings and research reports you can read on the page.

/education.title: Education — Ivan Ho
/education.description: Computer science and mathematics at Stanford, graduating 2028. Dux of King's College, Auckland, in 2024, with 7A* and 1A at Cambridge International A-Level.

/about.title: About — Ivan Ho
/about.description: I want to make fewer people strangers in their own world. On the intersection of technology, art and society, and on Schubert's wanderer.

/contact.description: Ways to get in touch with Ivan Le Kang Ho, and the languages he works in.
